text: Abyss of No Return: Deepest Part
If we leave that impostor as he is,\nmore people will be in danger...\nWe must defeat him no matter what.
And it should be a good offering for Balft,\nmy brother...\nCould you give me a hand?
...What? Tenert?\nHe said I was goofing off?
...Well, I know I'm usually like that,\nbut I'm doing it seriously this time.
Look!\nIt's not enough yet but just a lil' more to go...
I know!\nI'll collect it quickly and go back instantly!!
